items.question: What makes one collection different from another?
items.answer: Mostly where the work is done and how. Kolkata pieces are hand filigree, light for their size; Rajkot pieces are machine-finished and even; Temple and Antique are heavier, with deep antique finishes; Kuwait and Turkish are bright Gulf and Ottoman forms in 21K and 22K; Italian is mostly 18K chains and Diamonds are set in 18K. Each collection page lists its karats, the hallmark fineness for each, and what to look for on the tray.

items.question: Can I mix pieces from different collections?
items.answer: Yes. A set does not have to come from one tray: a Temple haar with Kolkata earrings, or Antique bangles with a Rajkot chain, is a normal wedding order. Karat matters more than collection when matching a set, so tell us whether you are starting from 22K, 21K or 18K and we will show pieces that sit together.

items.question: Does every branch carry every collection?
items.answer: Not always. Pieces move between trays and branches, and some collections arrive in batches during the year. Ask the branch you plan to visit, or message us on WhatsApp with the collection name and we will tell you which branch has it on the tray that day.
